svg.title: Issue 1 — Page 1 — Panel 5: Thresh at weapon rack in corridor (through bridge archway)
svg.desc: Medium wide shot, 35mm, framed through a bridge archway looking into the corridor beyond. Thresh stands at a wall-mounted weapon rack, back partially to camera, running her hands along a compact rifle with practiced efficiency, checking the charge by feel. Calm competence. Pristine ruby-crimson suit with heavier armor plating at shoulders, chest, forearms. Pre-fear-arc confidence — completely in her element. Bridge archway frames composition. Corridor lighting dimmer than bridge — blue-white overhead with red-crimson accent lighting along weapon rack reflecting off ruby suit. THRESH: "Weapons green."
